question: Cholesterol rich food can lead to:
solution:
The correct answer is __cardiovascular disease.____ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• High cholesterol is linked with a higher possibility of cardiovascular disease.
 
• That can involve coronary heart disease, stroke, and peripheral vascular disease. 
 
• High cholesterol has also been tied to diabetes and high blood pressure.
 
• Retain your cholesterol and triglyceride levels under control to stop cardiovascular disease.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Muscular dystrophy is a syndrome that causes increasing weakness and loss of muscle mass.
 
• Osteomalacia is the tag of a state where bones become soft and weak. 
 
• Dementia is caused by damage to or swap in the brain.
